line: It was carved for my clutch. It comes back to me.
The bone figurine is mine, friend. It was carved for my clutch.
I would be glad to have it back. It should come home to me.
The figurine, the charm and the beads. All three. Good.
You have the figurine, the charm and the beads. Good. You have my thanks.
Here is eighty gold. Please, take it.
Yes, it is worn smooth. It is older than my clutch.
I will pay fifty gold for it. No more.
Yes, you are right. It is worn smooth. It is older than my clutch.
I will pay you fifty gold for it, friend. I trust you will take it.
